headline: Architect and BIM Lead
summary: Licensed architect with ten years designing schools, clinics and commercial buildings in Mindanao, the last four leading BIM for a design-build firm. I take projects from concept to construction documents in Revit, AutoCAD and SketchUp, integrate structural and MEP engineering into the design, and coordinate consultants and site teams.
highlights: Led the move from 2D drafting to Revit BIM for a 15-person design team.
Designed a 3-storey provincial learning centre that finished within 2% of budget.
Cut drawing clashes found on site by about 70% through coordinated BIM models.
skills: Integrating structural and MEP engineering in design
CAD standards and BIM execution plans

bullets: Lead a BIM team of six on schools, clinics and commercial buildings.
